task: T2/R6 real-target in-vivo battery (target + adjacent cells)

config.window_rule: w0 = HOP + j*4*HOP (d43), 128 windows per 131072-sweep file
config.hybrid_path: d43 convention: network_out_batch(chunk=64) + statistic_from_net, main csep_prep (no Cinv)
config.anmf_path: deployed per-unit dl0.001 eigen path (d43 recipe)

nu_correlation.definition: Spearman rho between per-cell MoM nu-hat and the per-cell apparent detection rate, ADJACENT cells pooled across the 8 files

notes: NO GROUND TRUTH: every rate is an APPARENT per-window exceedance rate at the deployed 1e-3 thresholds; adjacent-cell rates are the in-vivo false-alarm reading, not certified Pfa.

Adjacent-cell ANMF secondaries include the target cell (cells +/-4 geometry); target leakage into the covariance biases the ANMF statistic DOWN on adjacent cells (conservative for false alarms) and is caveated.

The target cell itself is contaminated (target present): its rates mix target evidence with in-vivo clutter false alarms; the primary-vs-adjacent contrast, not the raw target rate, is the quantity of interest.
CNN firing on adjacent cells vs per-cell MoM nu-hat: see nu_correlation; correlation does not establish mechanism.
Doppler/walk/width are estimated from clear-band periodogram peaks of the raw target-cell VV (no separation stage); weak-target files can have clutter-dominated peaks.
Guards: G2 CNN scoring path exact vs d40_scores_pool77; G1 target-cell hybrid/ANMF rates reproduce d43_real_target.json per file exactly.
